payload.description:
Purpose: finish 8f98f8 / Test 2 now that Chromium is in the computer image. e747d7 measured Fargate RUNNING only; browser-ready was recorded as incomplete.

Acceptance:
- Repeat about five cold summons with ChatticusComputers desiredCount still 0 (RunTask, then stop leftover tasks).
- Record distribution for Fargate RUNNING and Chromium-ready (browser gate), plus cache effects vs e747d7.
- Write results under spikes/computer-cold-start (throwaway spike, not python/src).
- Update docs/DESIGN_CHALLENGES.md challenge 5 and docs/FEASIBILITY_TESTS.md per the feasibility-test rules.
- Do not optimize the image or CDK during measurement.
- No cdk deploy --all, no production, no Snapshots/Computers destroy, no 35d86b / PR #26.
payload.title: Measure cold Chromium-ready on summoned Fargate
